description: This file is a C header file (.h) defining interfaces related to 802.11 protocol parsing and capabilities. It includes function prototypes for parsing association bodies and retrieving maximum PHY rates, as well as necessary includes and include guards.

methods.name: map_80211_parse_assoc_body
methods.description: Parses the association/re-association body to retrieve station capabilities, verifies the SSID if provided, and indicates whether the station is connected to 2G or not.

methods.name: map_get_max_phy_rate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum physical rate in kbps based on provided station capabilities.
